$description: Tier 3 — component tokens. Resolve to semantic tokens only.

dotSize.$description: The status/unread DOT — one definition for the whole estate, not one per component. It is 6px and not the on-grid 8 on purpose: beside 14px label text an 8px dot reads as a bullet rather than a signal, and 6 is what the Figma masters render and what Material and Carbon both publish. It carries a literal rather than an alias because no `size/*` step is 6 and inventing one would put a scale step in the system for a single affordance — the same reasoning `accessibilityBar/height` (46) and `flagWidth` (33) already follow. Bound by `.ds-badge__dot` AND `.ds-tabs__badge`: when this moves, every dot moves.

dotSizeLg.$description: The dot beside 16px body text — Badge `lg`, and Tabs at `size="l"`. A dot is sized relative to the type it annotates, not to its container, which is why this steps with the type scale and not with the control height.

bg.$description: BETA badge background — ad-hoc accent (#ffd323), NOT a brand or status colour. Correctly-named entry point for the beta-badge colour.

accessibilityBar.$description: AccessibilityBar (UX4G/GIGW top utility bar). Component-scoped dimensions and inverse state layers that mirror the Figma master 1:1. They live in Tier 3 because they are the bar's own geometry — a 46px bar height and a 33px flag chip are not shared scale steps, and the inverse overlays only make sense on this bar's brand fill.

flagWidth.$description: Flag/emblem chip width (Figma layout/flag/width); height is {size.22}, a 3:2 chip.

dividerColor.$description: Divider ink on the brand fill (Figma border/neutral/inverse-subtle, #ffffff66 = 40%). Pre-composited so consumers never hand-roll an opacity.

pillBg.$description: ACTIVE state layer — Figma `overlay/on-brand/pressed`, #ffffff29 = 16%. Per the component's States documentation, ACTIVE covers BOTH senses: a control being pressed, AND the current selection (the middle A at default size). One value, two meanings, deliberately — the name still says `pill` for historical reasons and is flagged for a rename.

hoverBg.$description: HOVER state layer for the bar's controls on the brand fill — Figma `overlay/on-brand/hover`, #ffffff14 = 8%. It carried 0.12 until 2026-08-18, an invented value that disagreed with the published variable and with the component's own States documentation. `overlay/on-brand/*` has no Tier-2 name in code yet (the grammar has no `on-brand` family), which is why this mirrors it at Tier 3 rather than aliasing it.

stepSize.$description: A- / A+ step button hit area. 24 is the WCAG 2.2 AA Target Size (Minimum) floor exactly, so this token may never go below it.

iconButtonSize.$description: Accessibility / language icon-button hit area. Was a raw 28px literal in the component CSS until 2026-08-18; 28 sits one step above the WCAG 2.2 AA 24px floor because these buttons carry a glyph plus, for language, a text label.
